117:t_2:36.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「See ya. I'm gonna go say hi to $$スメラギ$$ and ask her about the Colonel... I mean, the Brigadier General's campus days.」

117:t_2:39.en:
$$グラハム$$
「But that straightforwardness... I'd like to learn from it.」

117:t_2:40.en:
$$アムロ$$
「True. Maybe things would go better if people were more honest with themselves.」

117:t_2:41.en:
$$グラハム$$
(Keep holding on to the feeling, and it will reach him...)

117:t_2:42.en:
$$グラハム$$
($$刹那・Ｆ・セイエイ$$... As long as I have this feeling, I can keep moving forward...)

117:t_2:43.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Come to think of it, where's $$刹那$$?」

117:t_2:44.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「He said he was going to see $$スメラギ$$.」

117:t_2:45.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Is it about today's battle?」

117:t_2:46.en:
$n
「It didn't seem like that kind of mood, though...」

117:t_2:50.en: ～ $$プトレマイオス２改$$ $$スメラギ$$'s Quarters ～

117:t_2:52.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...Looks like we couldn't keep it hidden after all.」

117:t_2:53.en:
$$刹那$$
「Tell me. What exactly is happening to $$エスター$$?」

117:t_2:54.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...According to Dr. $$トライア$$, she's in a state right now where you can't call her either alive or dead.」

117:t_2:56.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Dr. $$トライア$$ is doing everything she can to treat her. All we can do is wait.」

117:t_2:58.en:
$$刹那$$
「I understand. I won't tell anyone.」

117:t_2:59.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(...Just as the town of $$オーティス$$ was tossed around by the multiverse, her fate was twisted by $$次元力$$...)

117:t_2:60.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(This world that began with the 《$$大時空震動$$》... Where on earth is it heading...)

117:t_2:64.en: ～ $$セントラル・ベース$$, Command Room ～

117:t_2:65.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ehh? So you're telling me you fled the battlefield with your tail between your legs, $$ギルター$$?」

117:t_2:67.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Ours is a frank sort of unit, so talking casually to me, your superior, is perfectly fine, but...」

117:t_2:68.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「A report delivered in that kind of lashing-out tone is a bit... no, very much unacceptable, I'm afraid.」

117:t_2:70.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Burning with fighting spirit like that isn't a bad thing. It's exactly what our boss likes.」

117:t_2:71.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「So, here is your chance to make up for it. Please take command of the defense force at $$セントラル・ベース$$.」

117:t_2:72.en:
$$ギルター$$
「You're giving me a chance?」

117:t_2:73.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「To be honest, I'm at a certain age, so I'd rather not go out to the front lines too much...」

117:t_2:74.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I will make the most of the opportunity I've been given! I'll show them my true power!」

117:t_2:75.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Real or fake, I don't care, so please just deliver results.」

117:t_2:76.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「The boss has been awfully on edge lately, you see.」

117:t_2:78.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Now, now... isn't this just business as usual?」

117:t_2:79.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「If you don't want to die, you'd better try hard. And I mean risk-your-life hard.」

117:t_2:80.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Understood! I, $$ギルター・ベローネ$$, will carry out my mission with every ounce of my strength!」

117:t_2:81.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(Your words are so light, you know... Spit out some of those pitch-black feelings that well up from the depths of your heart.)

117:t_2:82.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(Well... it would be unbearable to have a lot of people like the boss around, though...)

117:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's been a while, Mr. $$グラハム$$. You seem to be in awfully good spirits.」

117:t_10:5.en:
$$グラハム$$
「$$ＡＧ$$, is it...? You're quite right.」

117:t_10:6.en:
$$グラハム$$
「I have no doubts now. I will simply keep moving forward on the path I have chosen.」

117:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「An answer found at the end of your doubts... I pray you never lose sight of it again.」

117:t_10:8.en:
$$グラハム$$
「You know about my past?」

117:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, you know... Information is a dimensional merchant's lifeline.」

117:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So you'd rather I not touch on it, after all?」

117:t_10:11.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Even my past shames were needed to shape who I am now. I have no intention of denying them.」

117:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How admirable, Mr. $$グラハム$$. This is Bushido at its absolute peak!」

117:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... I sense a threat to my life if I go any further, so I think I'll hold back.」

117:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Messing with a serious opponent is seriously dangerous, you know.」

117:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Come, come... to change the mood, join me! Let's cut our bellies open again today...」

117:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「B-business, business! I'm really going to hold back!!」

118:t_000:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「We've broken through the enemy defense line! $$ターミナル・ベース$$ is entering the combat zone!」

118:t_000:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「They built a base like this just to flaunt it...!」

118:t_000:2.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「The enemy interception force is coming!」

118:t_001:0.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Leave it to a $$ターミナル・ベース$$, huh. They've gone and lined up nothing but genuine $$サイデリアル$$ machines.」

118:t_001:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「But we've never confirmed an $$アンゲロイ$$ type in that color scheme before.」

118:t_001:2.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Whatever the enemy is, all we can do is push forward... Right, $$ティエリア$$?」

118:t_001:3.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Yes. We cannot allow fear to stop us in our tracks.」

118:t_001:4.en:
$$カツ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$... she's really fired up.」

118:t_001:5.en:
$$フォウ$$
「We can't let ourselves be outdone.」

118:t_002:2.en:
$n
(Is it just me...? $$ジェニオン$$'s output is more stable than usual, too...)

118:t_002:3.en:
$n
(Is the $$スフィア$$ responding to my will...?)

118:t_003:0.en:
$$オットー$$
「Attention all units! We're taking out the enemy defense force and seizing this base!」

118:t_003:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「Our victory leads to the victory of the entire army! Don't forget that!」

118:t_003:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「All units, begin the attack! We're taking this enemy base!」

118:t_004:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Reaction from $$ターミナル・ベース$$! Something is coming out!」

118:t_004:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, be careful! Reinforcements are coming!」

118:t_005:0.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「That machine... it must be the squad leader's unit...!」

118:t_005:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I'll give you credit, $c. But this is as far as you go.」

118:t_005:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「I am $$ギルター・ベローネ$$. Commander of this base, and the last opponent you will face.」
